close_reason: doc comment updated to reflect v0.2 implementation; dedicated test fixture for empty-subject+critical-SAN chain tracked for v0.3 since it requires custom DER cert construction
description:
pkix-path/src/lib.rs:994-1001 — the comment documents a known v0.1 limitation:
  'cert with an empty Subject and critical SAN will pass this check but fail name linkage since names_match compares against the empty Subject. This is tracked for v0.2 (RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6).'

The cert_has_san_identity function (line 1344-1356) correctly identifies such certs. The chain_walk code at line 2039-2043 correctly skips DN-based name linkage for such certs. The SAN-identity handling appears to be implemented.

However, there is no test that:
1. Validates a chain where an intermediate CA has empty Subject + critical SAN
2. Confirms that such a cert does NOT trigger ChainBroken when the next cert's issuer field doesn't match

This is a P2 test coverage gap: the code path is implemented but untested with a real certificate fixture.

Additionally, the HANDLED_CRITICAL_OIDS comment at line 998-1000 says SAN value is 'not inspected by path validation — name matching still uses the Subject DN.' This is now partially incorrect (cert_has_san_identity is called and working_issuer_is_san_identity changes behavior). The comment should be updated.
title: pkix-path: no test for empty-subject cert with critical SAN (RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6 edge case)
